layerEarthData.headerTitle: High-Resolution Airborne Magnetic Survey - Central Arabian Shield
layerEarthData.headerDescription: The magnetic anomaly layer shows variations in Earth's magnetic field caused by different rock compositions beneath the surface, used to identify geological formations, deep structures, and mineral exploration.
layerEarthData.detailsContent: This layer displays geophysical data from the high-resolution airborne magnetic survey of the Central Arabian Shield. The layer reflects the variation in Total Magnetic Intensity (TMI) for the central region, providing essential data for understanding subsurface geological structure and exploring mineral and hydrocarbon resources.

about.introP1: The National Geological Database forms the cornerstone of the mineral wealth and mining information management system in the Kingdom. This database will contribute to increasing the value realized from the mining sector as it is one of the fundamental pillars in the national economy and the state's Vision 2030. In addition, it allows investors and researchers in the field of earth sciences and mining to access data and information of the National Geological Database on the internet through a set of electronic portals. The databases include detailed geological surveying and exploration works and mining data of mineral wealth in the Kingdom. They also contain exploration information for assessing mineral resources in addition to geological exploration and prospecting activity data and drilling data available for multiple projects in the state.
about.introP2: The Saudi Geological Survey possesses within its spatial database system a wide range of spatial information and applications developed at the Authority to serve beneficiaries including researchers and experts in earth science data search and analysis operations, to serve state interests through the Authority's activities in the fields of geological surveying, exploration, studies and research, which constitute a large proportion of the data required to be available in the National Geological Database. The National Geological Database targets the following:
about.goal1: Unifying mineral wealth and mining data and information in the Kingdom.
about.goal2: Developing and governing the infrastructure of the National Geological Database.
about.task1: Retrieving geological data for multiple geological surveying and exploration projects in the country from geotechnical reports and geological maps previously issued.
about.task2: Developing analytical tools in spatial information systems and digital solutions to enable decision-makers to manage and benefit from the country's mineral resources.
about.task3: Providing scientific institutions and mining-related entities with base maps, geological maps, engineering and environmental maps, and geological hazard maps.
about.task4: Managing national earth science databases by granting permissions to individuals and institutions related to earth science branches in the Kingdom and abroad.
about.task5: Providing electronic services and spatial and digital data in both Arabic and English, and developing electronic dictionaries for scientific and technical terms used in mining, map production, and various earth science applications.
about.task6: Building a digital library of various processed satellite sensor imagery to serve geological surveying and exploration projects, natural hazard monitoring, environmental studies, and natural resource exploitation in the country.
about.task7: Building and managing the electronic portal for the national drilling information virtual digital library.
about.task8: Attracting and training Saudi personnel in spatial information systems and their applications in earth sciences.
about.task9: Exchanging scientific information and data in geographic information systems and remote sensing with government agencies, companies, local and international geological and mining research centers, and institutions working in various earth science fields.

webPortalQuestionnaire.title: National Geological Information Portal Survey
webPortalQuestionnaire.subtitle: Survey for SGS Portal Users
webPortalQuestionnaire.description1: Within the framework of Saudi Arabia"s Vision 2030, the Royal Council has tasked the Saudi Geological Survey with developing and hosting the National Geological Database (NGD). Improving the data portal and its products and services is an essential part of this database. As a result, new datasets and download features were published on the NGD web portal on December 9, 2021, and January 11, 2022.
webPortalQuestionnaire.description2: Another fundamental aspect of developing the National Geological Database is stakeholder engagement. This electronic survey is directed at investors and users of the NGD data portal. This survey aims to enhance stakeholder participation and collect information and opinions to be utilized in database development.

geoInfoPortal.aboutDescription:
The National Geological Information Portal in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is an advanced digital platform aimed at providing accurate and comprehensive geological data serving researchers, investors, and government and private entities.
The portal provides a unified window for access to a wealth of specialized information in the fields of:
geoInfoPortal.surveyText: The Saudi Geological Survey directs a survey to investors and users of the National Geological Database portal with the aim of enhancing stakeholder participation and collecting information and opinions to be utilized in database development
geoInfoPortal.goalsDescription: The portal aims to achieve a set of strategic goals that serve sustainable development, enable beneficiary entities to access accurate and up-to-date information, and among the most prominent of these goals:
geoInfoPortal.goal1: Providing a reliable and integrated source for national geological data
geoInfoPortal.goal1Description: Through collecting, updating and displaying geological information in an organized and easily accessible manner.
geoInfoPortal.goal2Description: By enabling government and private entities to access data that helps in planning and development.
geoInfoPortal.goal3: Stimulating scientific research and innovation in earth sciences
geoInfoPortal.goal3Description: By facilitating academics and researchers' access to a vast amount of maps, studies and reports.
geoInfoPortal.goal4Description: By providing visual and interactive content that clarifies the importance of geology in human life, environment and development.
geoInfoPortal.goal5Description: By facilitating the exchange of data and expertise with relevant entities inside and outside the Kingdom.
geoInfoPortal.conclusionText: The portal represents part of the Kingdom's strategy to enhance digital transformation in the geology sector, and support Saudi Vision 2030 by encouraging exploration and investment in natural resources according to the latest technologies.

We provide this manual in both Arabic and English to ensure that information reaches all users, wherever they are.
